from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Party(BaseModel):
    """Captures a named party involved in the case."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Full name of the party")
    role: str | None = Field(description="Role in the case, e.g. Appellant, Applicant")

class MonetaryItem(BaseModel):
    """Captures specific financial figures or fees mentioned in the document."""
    amount: str | None = Field(description="The specific amount mentioned")
    description: str | None = Field(description="What the amount refers to, e.g. Case Fee, Debt")
    responsible_party: str | None = Field(description="Who bears the responsibility for the amount")

class Document(BaseModel):
    """Core data model for extracting information from a single judgment document."""
    document_type: str | None = Field(description="Type of legal document (e.g., Criminal Appeal, Civil Judgment)")
    court_location: str | None = Field(description="Court name or location mentioned in the document")
    parties: list[Party] = Field(description="List of named parties and their roles")
    monetary_items: list[MonetaryItem] = Field(description="List of amounts and fees found in the document")
    case_identifier: str | None = Field(description="Case number or key document identifier")
    decision_text: str | None = Field(description="Summary of the ruling or decision outcome")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[Document]
